strategy.summary: Complete the narrow three-bank to light the spinner, repeat the lit spinner, and use the two side locks plus the center ramp for three-ball Multiball when the ramp is safe.

quickInfo.name: Spinner bank
quickInfo.summary: The narrow three-bank beside the spinner raises its value.

quickInfo.name: Ball locks
quickInfo.summary: Each side lock holds one ball, and opponents can use balls that are already locked.

quickInfo.name: Multiball
quickInfo.summary: The center ramp starts two-ball or three-ball Multiball according to how many balls are locked.

quickInfo.name: U-S-A lanes
quickInfo.summary: The top lanes advance the end-of-ball multiplier, and the flipper buttons change the lit lane.

quickInfo.name: S-H-U-T-T-L-E
quickInfo.summary: Standups add bonus, and completing the word collects the currently lit award.

steps.text: From the right flipper, find the narrow angle that clips the spinner three-bank.
From the left flipper, shoot through the spinner after its value is built.
Repeat bank and spinner work while both returns remain controlled.
Lock one ball on each side when the lock kickouts are safe.
With two balls locked, shoot the center ramp to start three-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, repeat the lit spinner and finish useful S-H-U-T-T-L-E or U-S-A progress.

fallback.title: Spinner-only route
fallback.when: Use this when the center ramp rejects or the side locks do not return safely.

steps.text: Stop shooting the ramp and locks.
Use the right flipper to work the narrow spinner bank.
Use the left flipper to repeat the spinner.
Use lane change to collect missing U-S-A lanes during natural top play.

alternatives.title: Fast two-ball start
alternatives.when: Use this when one ball is locked and the center ramp is safer than the second lock.

steps.text: Confirm that one ball is locked.
Shoot the center ramp to start two-ball Multiball.
Use the extra ball to repeat the spinner and finish bank progress.

alternatives.title: 100,000 SHUTTLE collect
alternatives.when: Use this when one letter remains and the lit award is 100,000.

steps.text: Check the lit award before the final letter.
Use the ramp bullseye to change the award only when its rebound is safe.
Complete the last S-H-U-T-T-L-E letter at 100,000.
Complete the spinner three-bank.
Lock one ball on each side.
Start three-ball Multiball at the center ramp.
Repeat the built spinner during protected play.
Use U-S-A lane change to build the largest available Bonus X.

techniques.name: Spinner-bank clip
techniques.instruction: From the right flipper, aim at the thin target edge beside the spinner instead of shooting straight through its lane.

cautions.issue: A short center-ramp shot can return through the middle.
cautions.response: Shoot the ramp only with full flipper strength and abandon it after a reject.

cautions.issue: Bumper exits and direct standup rebounds can remove control.
cautions.response: Favor the spinner and completed lock shots over direct standup attacks.

cautions.issue: Locked balls can be used by the next player.
cautions.response: Start Multiball in the same ball when a valuable lock state is ready and the ramp is safe.

strategy.simpleOverview: In Space Shuttle, the narrow three-bank lights the spinner for repeatable scoring. Lock one ball on each side and shoot the center ramp for three-ball Multiball. Use U-S-A lane change to improve Bonus X whenever the ball returns upstairs.
strategy.overview: In Space Shuttle, completing the narrow three-bank lights the spinner, while one lock on each side plus the center ramp starts Multiball. Repeat the lit spinner when its return is controlled; take both locks and the ramp only when the center shot is safe. During protected play, return to the built spinner and use flipper-button lane change to finish U-S-A for Bonus X.
